title: Payload Prober: Compact Failure Lens for Rapid Triage
creator: Marina Gomez
description:
Goal: Design a compact, horizontally-stackable failure lens (Payload Prober) that surfaces the minimum set of artifacts engineers need to triage failed inference requests quickly. The lens should be embeddable in dashboards, attach to rollout views, and be usable as a transient overlay from a request table row. Focus areas: condensed metadata, payload diff snapshots, retry-origin timeline, error taxonomy hints, and a lightweight interactive payload inspector.

Success criteria:
- 1-click entry from request table and rollout detail screens.
- Shows top-3 error classifications and confidence, with inline guidance on typical remediation.
- Presents a delta view for input -> model prompt -> output with quick-copy and open-in-debug options.
- Provides a ‘replay with modified prompt’ micro-flow that uses stored KV snapshots and shows expected latency impact.
- Prototype must fit within a 420px-wide side rail and degrade gracefully to a full-screen modal for complex traces.

Constraints and considerations:
- Must avoid duplicating full Debug Traceboard: this is a fast-path tool for first-pass triage.
- Respect RBAC and audit logging: actions that trigger replays or retries must annotate the request record.
- Keep tokenized payloads private in the UI unless policy permits redaction hints.

Deliverables:
- High-fidelity Figma prototype for side rail + modal states.
- Interaction spec describing keyboard flows and focus management.
- Hand-off tokens and copy to content designer for remediation hints.
- Accessibility notes for screen-reader descriptions of payload snippets.
comments: 2026-02-12 - Kickoff: Reviewed backlog with ENG and PM. Agreed the compact lens should prioritize triage speed over exhaustive telemetry. Action: Asha to sketch three density variants (compact / standard / expanded).

2026-02-18 - Design review: Presented density variants to runtime and infra leads. Feedback: include an explicit ‘fallback lineage’ chip that shows model variant fallbacks and region failovers. Added to prototype scope.

2026-02-22 - PM feedback: Requested that the replay attempt be available only when request size < 4MB and customer policy allows. Added label for policy gating and an inline tooltip in the action menu.
2026-02-28 - Prototype iteration: Switched from a stacked accordion to a horizontal micro-tab for error taxonomy / payload / retry timeline to reduce vertical scroll within 420px rail.

2026-03-05 - Usability session: 5 engineers. Observations: users expected 'copy prompt' affordance next to prompt diff; suggested a small 'simulate' button that previews token cost before replay. Added micro-copy cost preview to CTA.
2026-03-09 - Dev sync: Runtime team flagged KV snapshot retention TTL as a hard constraint. Action: PM to capture acceptable default TTL and opt-in override. Added dependency ENG-128412 to ticket.
2026-03-10 - Design hand-off ready for In Review: Figma link + interaction spec uploaded. Next: create PRD page and schedule design review with compliance for redaction flows.
notes:
Design trade-offs: we intentionally show only top error taxonomy matches (with confidence) to avoid overwhelming triage owners. If confidence < 40% we show a ‘Suggest eval’ action which opens Redwood Optimize prompt test harness.

Open questions:
- Should the replay micro-flow write an audit event and require explicit confirmation when the customer is on a restricted plan? (PM leaning: yes)
- How to represent truncated redacted tokens consistently across environments? Proposed: gray-strikethrough with hover tooltip containing redaction reason.

Next steps:
- Schedule compliance review (owner: Nina Chowdhury)
- Create engineering spike to validate KV snapshot read throughput for inline replays (owner: ENG runtime lead)
